Package com.signalwire.sdk.relay

Class Message

java.lang.Object
com.signalwire.sdk.relay.Message
public class Message extends Object
Represents an SMS/MMS message with state tracking.

Messages are simpler than calls: they have a message_id, progress through states (queued, initiated, sent, delivered), and support completion waiting.

State progression:

  • Success: queued -> initiated -> sent -> delivered
  • Failure: queued -> initiated -> failed/undelivered
Terminal states: delivered, undelivered, failed

    • getMessageState

      public Optional<MessageState> getMessageState()
      The current message state as a typed MessageState, alongside the raw string getState() (which stays canonical for parity and forward-compat). Returns Optional.empty() when the live wire state is not one of the seven known MessageState values — the set mirrors server-emitted values that can grow, so an unrecognised state is tolerated here rather than crashing the caller. The present value always agrees with getState(): getMessageState().get().getValue().equals(getState()).
      Returns:
      the typed state, or empty if the raw state is unknown/unset.
